note: Shoshone NF (Clarks Fork RD) camping area on Lily Lake, 0.75 mile up the Beartooth Highway (US-212) from the Chief Joseph Scenic Highway, then 1 mile in on Forest Road 128. Being rebuilt as of November 2025 to seven sites with a boat launch; three shared bear boxes, no fire rings yet. No garbage collection. --Claude
